anti_patterns.name: Raw SQL string interpolation
anti_patterns.description: User-supplied values are concatenated directly into SQL query strings at the login and user-lookup handlers instead of using parameterized statements, turning every input-bearing query into an injection sink.

anti_patterns.name: Secrets hardcoded in source
anti_patterns.description: The session signing key and database credentials are embedded as string literals in committed source files, making them available to anyone with repository read access and impossible to rotate without a code change.

findings.label: Hardcoded JWT signing key in server.js

anti_patterns.name: Missing server-side authorization layer
anti_patterns.description: State-changing and data-access routes are registered without authentication or ownership enforcement, leaving every caller equally privileged to reach admin, user-record, and AI-assistant endpoints.

findings.label: Missing authorization on user record endpoint
